items.question: What world-transcending deed of Śrīpura will the speaker now declare for the listener to hear?
premises: The speaker announces a forthcoming account.
The deed is described as world-transcending.
items.inference: The verse frames a transition to narrating Śrīpura's transcendent deed.
uncertainties: Whether Śrīpura denotes the city, goddess, or sacred domain remains context-dependent.
items.plain_english: Now I will speak the world-transcending deed of Śrīpura; listen.
